* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Interrupt: Podracer Collision, Tatooine, U
|strategy=By Eric Olson<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/podracercollision.html</ref>

This card has two very useful functions. A lot of popular Light decks use recycling interrupts like Fall of a Legend or [[Throw Me Another Charge]] which look through their decks to recycle high destiny interrupts. This card lets you punish your opponent for using cards just to look through their reserve deck or playing interrupts which don't really do anything. The Used portion of this card lets you look through their Reserve Deck and place any interrupt you find there out of play. If you're packing a couple of this interrupt, you can make your opponent think twice before looking for a [[Weather Vane (Dark){{!}}Weather Vane]].

The Lost portion is also useful. If your Dark deck is podracing, you will definitely want to run multiples of this card. This interrupt will set Anakin's racer back, giving you more time to finish the race; even better, the card that goes back to the Light player's hand might be just enough to create a tie, which all but guarantees a [[Sebulba]] win.
